title_en: Dream of the Red Chamber (9/20): Qingwen Is Driven Out
note_en: 正因为 means "precisely because": 正因为她太出众，……反而对她心生嫉妒 "precisely because she stood out so much, (people) grew jealous of her instead." 正 sharpens the cause, and 反而 in the second half marks a result contrary to what you'd expect (you'd expect admiration). English needs two separate words, "precisely" and "instead," to do the same job.
